events.name: retired
events.semantics: Retired RV32IM instructions; exclude first setStats entry, include second.

events.name: loads
events.semantics: Retired integer loads in the retired-PC ROI.

events.name: stores
events.semantics: Retired integer stores in the retired-PC ROI.

events.name: branches
events.semantics: RV32IM branches including JAL and JALR; model execute statistics can differ from retirement.

scope: RV32IM example, two microbenchmarks, physical uncached memory. Model trends only.
uncertainty: One measurement per model. No repeatability estimate or confidence interval.
unsupported: Speculative requests, cache misses, stall and replay causes
